plan.notes: Transcribed from the official CRC 'Construction A.S. Degree - Local GE' program map, Catalog Year 2026-2027, published September 23, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7897/PublishedPdf). GE Pattern: CRC Local GE. Map states Total Units 59-62; lower bound 59 used = 15+15+16+13 (semester sums verified at lower bounds: Sem 2 Area L2 3-4 -> 3; Sem 4 Elective 1-3 -> 1). Semester 4 elective: map suggests CONST 103 OSHA 10 Hour Safety Training (1 unit), which meets requirements for the Certificate in Construction Pre-Apprenticeship and the Certificate in Construction; elective units determined by the number needed to total 60 units for graduation. Advisories (CMT 300: concurrent CMT 310; BIT 102: ADT 300 & BIT 100; CMT 310/112/136: CMT 300) are recommendations only, recorded in choice_notes, never as prereqs.
